intro: Closing is done per facility. The unsettled remainder of each approved commitment is carried over to the next year, on the line with the same code; unpaid settlements remain payable. Nothing is deleted.
confirmation: Close this year for this facility?
avertissement: Remainders will be carried over to the next year. Reopening does not cancel them.
cloturee: Year closed: {{nombre}} commitment(s) carried over, {{montant}} XOF.
